title: An afternoon in Valdilume
opening: The bus has left you on Valdilume's little piazza, with the afternoon to yourself. Slate roofs step up toward wooded foothills; distant higher peaks show between television aerials. A café door stands open. Beside it, someone is slowly teaching a bicycle bell to ring less indignantly. Water runs below the narrow lane. You have a charged phone, a pocket notebook and pencil, a light jacket, and enough spending money for an ordinary day. You can go where you like.
cap_ending: The streetlights come on above Valdilume. You leave the village to its evening, taking the afternoon with you.

piazza.name: Piazza del Tiglio
piazza.desc: A small paved square around a lime tree and a drinking fountain. Apartment balconies carry laundry and satellite dishes. The café faces the bicycle workshop; a lane drops toward running water.

bus_stop.name: Bus shelter
bus_stop.desc: A glass shelter with a local bus timetable and a working departure display. A return service connects to the rail station down the valley. You can wait here or choose to board and leave; merely arriving does not end the afternoon.

cafe.name: Bar del Tiglio
cafe.desc: An espresso machine hisses behind a zinc counter. A handwritten cake label and a contactless card reader sit together. Daylight falls across two empty tables and a box of mismatched coasters.

arcade.name: Short arcade
arcade.desc: Three shallow arches shelter bicycles, a parcel locker and a noticeboard with ordinary village notices. The workshop door is open beyond the last arch.

alley.name: Vicolo delle Lastre
alley.desc: A lane of irregular stone slabs between inhabited houses. A television murmurs through an upstairs window. A sloping passage reaches the stream; a stair returns to the square.

stream_bridge.name: Footbridge over the Rio
stream_bridge.desc: A low footbridge crosses clear running water, protected by sound metal railings. The water amplifies tiny sounds. A flat path follows the bank; the bus shelter is visible through the trees.

upper_lane.name: Via Alta
upper_lane.desc: A residential lane above the square, with recycling bins, climbing roses and an electric scooter plugged into a garage. The woods begin above the last roofs.

church_steps.name: San Lorenzo steps
church_steps.desc: Broad shallow steps beside a modest parish church. The doors stand open to a quiet public interior; no ceremony is underway. Stone seats catch afternoon sun and the distant sound of a motorbike.

cycle_shop.name: Enzo’s cycle workshop
cycle_shop.desc: A modern workstand holds an elderly town bicycle. An electric cargo bike waits beside chargers and labelled tool drawers. A box of clean discarded reflectors is marked for anyone to use.

cafe_courtyard.name: Bar courtyard
cafe_courtyard.desc: Three tables occupy a courtyard no bigger than a room. A lemon tree grows in a wheeled pot; its shelter for winter is folded beside it. Two doors belong to private apartments.

washhouse.name: Old washhouse
washhouse.desc: A restored communal washing trough stands under a slate roof. Water still runs through it. The wide dry rim is a comfortable place for a notebook, an improvised percussion experiment or a quiet pause.

lower_terrace.name: Terrace above the roofs
lower_terrace.desc: A public terrace reached by shallow steps. Television aerials and chimneys frame the valley. There is a bench, an empty plant pot and no sign telling you what to appreciate.

library.name: Village library
library.desc: A small municipal lending room with novels, a printer and public Wi-Fi. A computer displays a perfectly ordinary opening-hours spreadsheet. A cabinet holds the catalogue for a tiny local collection.

reading_garden.name: Library reading garden
reading_garden.desc: Folding chairs stand between pots of rosemary. A low wall separates this open garden from the stream path. Two spare chairs can be carried into the shade and brought back.

sound_room.name: Samir’s repair room
sound_room.desc: A street-level room for mending radios, speakers and small electronics. A multimeter and a laptop sit on a tidy bench. Through the open window the washhouse water sounds unexpectedly loud.

stream_path.name: Streamside path
stream_path.desc: A level footpath links the old lanes to the community rooms. Moving water, shoes on gravel and a distant ventilation fan make different rhythms. It is an ordinary safe public path.

archive.name: Local collection room
archive.desc: A dry little room off the library with labelled photographs, loaned objects and a public listening station. Nothing here is an undiscovered treasure; the pleasure is in looking closely.
archive.blocked: The local collection room is closed; Marta keeps its key in the library.

allotments.name: Shared garden plots
allotments.desc: Several tiny growing plots stand above the inhabited lanes. A shared hose winds between bean poles and late tomatoes. Two unclaimed raised beds have been left available for experiments, with a sign asking people to leave paths clear.

greenhouse.name: Patchwork greenhouse
greenhouse.desc: A sound greenhouse assembled from mismatched salvaged windows. Labels show plant names and sowing dates. A public workbench holds spare pots; somebody has drawn faces on the least successful seedlings.

chestnut_path.name: Chestnut path
chestnut_path.desc: A broad easy path climbs gently beneath chestnut trees. Fallen burrs sit beside the track, not across it. The village remains close below; the path is for ordinary shoes and unhurried walking.

picnic_wall.name: Long picnic wall
picnic_wall.desc: A low broad wall beside a public picnic table. A few roofs show through leaves. A refillable water bottle has a taped lost-property label; a recycling bin stands at the far end.

community_hall.name: Circolo hall
community_hall.desc: A modest community hall with a kettle, stacked chairs, accessible toilets and a modern noticeboard. It hosts whatever residents arrange; no event is compulsory today. A short corridor leads to the little screening room.

hall_forecourt.name: Circolo forecourt
hall_forecourt.desc: An open paved patch beside the hall. A faded hopscotch grid competes with markings for a game nobody has named. A gate connects the stream path and the bocce court.

bocce_court.name: Bocce court
bocce_court.desc: A level gravel court under mesh shade, with a painted bench and a handwritten reminder to put equipment away. A set of practice balls is available beside the bench. Watching is as acceptable as playing.

cinema.name: Little screening room
cinema.desc: Thirty mismatched seats face a white screen. A modern digital projector sits beyond a small rear window; it is disconnected. This is a room where neighbours occasionally watch films, not an abandoned cinema.

projection_booth.name: Projection cupboard
projection_booth.desc: A small ventilated equipment room behind the screening room. The digital projector has a labelled low-voltage power socket; its proper adapter is missing. The player need not touch mains wiring.
projection_booth.blocked: The equipment cupboard is locked; Ada looks after its key.

hardware.name: Ferramenta counter
hardware.desc: A tiny hardware shop with labelled drawers, phone chargers, door handles and seed trays. A printed card explains that repairs sometimes take longer than buying replacements. The rear yard is open while someone is here.

repair_yard.name: Hardware repair yard
repair_yard.desc: A sheltered yard behind the shop holds clean offcuts and a table for modest repairs. A discarded flat-pack shelf is available as scrap. Customer appliances and the electrical cupboard are clearly separate.

mill_lane.name: Via del Mulino
mill_lane.desc: A short paved lane beside the stream. The old mill building now has a fibre internet junction box and a shared-workspace sign. Its millwheel no longer turns and nobody is trying to make it turn today.

old_mill.name: Old mill common room
old_mill.desc: The mill’s ground floor is a public common room with working outlets, a kettle and tables. Above a glass panel, the preserved gearing can be seen without entering the machinery. A notice offers the room for small informal gatherings.

terraced_meadow.name: Lower meadow terrace
terraced_meadow.desc: A public grassy terrace between retaining walls, reached from the mill lane by a gentle path. A few old fruit trees provide shade. Village roofs and chestnut woods remain within sight.

ridge_path.name: Low ridge path
ridge_path.desc: A wide marked village path follows a low wooded ridge. It is below the high mountains, with no exposure or technical climbing. Between trunks the valley opens in brief windows. A sign points toward a small public shelter.

shelter.name: Ridge picnic shelter
shelter.desc: An open-sided timber shelter with a table, a public walking map and a notebook for ordinary observations. The village roofs are close below. This is a picnic shelter, not a staffed mountain refuge.

weather_corner.name: Weather notebook corner
weather_corner.desc: A small public clearing beside a simple rain gauge and a homemade wind ribbon. A label credits the local amateur weather group. There is a dry ledge to sit on while clouds change above the distant peaks.

viewpoint.name: Belvedere delle Betulle
viewpoint.desc: A broad fenced viewpoint above birch trees. The small settlement lies in the foreground, with larger foothills beyond. There is room for a photograph, a drawing, a deliberately bad poem or no activity at all.

upper_bench.name: Bench on the return path
upper_bench.desc: An unremarkable wooden bench on a gentle path connecting the ridge to the upper houses. Its view is mostly the back of a hedge. A small gap reveals the sky, which may be all the view needed.

phone.name: your smartphone
phone.desc: Charged, with ordinary fictional camera and notes functions; no real internet access or private knowledge.

notebook.name: your pocket notebook and pencil
notebook.desc: Several blank pages, a sharp pencil and enough room for a new idea.

wallet.name: your wallet
wallet.desc: Enough cash and a bank card for an ordinary day of small purchases; no financial puzzle.

chalk.name: a piece of pavement chalk
chalk.desc: A shared stub beside the public noticeboard, available for harmless drawings.

reflectors.name: a handful of spare reflectors
reflectors.desc: Clean plastic bicycle reflectors, freely available from the scrap box.

coasters.name: a stack of blank coasters
coasters.desc: Lucia keeps these for drawings or absurd labels.

coffee.name: a small espresso
coffee.desc: A freshly made cup offered by Lucia; the cup belongs to the bar.

inner_tube.name: a clean old inner tube
inner_tube.desc: Flexible discarded rubber for an inventive project; not a working bicycle part.

archive_key.name: the local collection key
archive_key.desc: Marta can lend this for the little room beside the library.

recorder.name: a pocket audio recorder
recorder.desc: A charged digital recorder for listening locally; no need to upload anything or record people without consent.

seed_mix.name: a packet of mixed flower seeds
seed_mix.desc: Giulia saved a small mixture for experiments rather than straight rows.

spare_pot.name: a small terracotta pot
spare_pot.desc: One of the freely available spare pots on the greenhouse bench.

practice_balls.name: a set of practice bocce balls
practice_balls.desc: Shared practice equipment; leave or return it after use.

booth_key.name: the projection cupboard key
booth_key.desc: Ada holds this for the small equipment room.

scrap_board.name: a clean scrap shelf board
scrap_board.desc: Available scrap from a discarded shelf in the hardware yard.

projector_adapter.name: the correct projector power adapter
projector_adapter.desc: Davide has checked this matching low-voltage adapter for the circolo projector; no rewiring required.

paper_tape.name: a roll of paper tape
paper_tape.desc: A partly used roll Davide keeps for temporary labels.

observation_card.name: a spare observation card
observation_card.desc: Rina’s card has room for the time, weather and something unmeasured.

paper_frame.name: a little cardboard viewfinder
paper_frame.desc: Teo cut a rectangular window in plain card to look without taking a photograph.
